role: The saddle (id 329): saddles a grown pig on right click on it (also on a hit, through hitEntity).

members.name: itemInteractionForEntity
members.note: server (survival.c process_c02_interact) and the client's copy (surv_client_entity_interact)

members.name: hitEntity
members.note: On a landed attack: itemInteractionForEntity(stack, null, target) saddles an unsaddled adult pig and spends the saddle, the answer is true whatever it hit so stat.useItem.329 counts, and a spent stack is destroyCurrentEquippedItem (combat.c, lane/idxblocks). idx-killcredit-s1 hits two pigs with saddles.

notes: The right-click saddle (itemInteractionForEntity) is ported in lane/ride and replays in ride-pig-s1.
